method.order: Rotate capacity and mode order per block, reverse word order on odd blocks; each child one warmup and one evaluation per case/mode; reloaded per capacity/block; all processes sequential
method.allocation: Initialization graph reservation only, not peak RSS; physical KV stays resident within task/load
method.excluded: Load, helper first/warm execution and each child warmup; independent tokenizer oracle subtracted, raw whole wall retained

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; scripted model actions, no autonomous-quality score
GPU spans are buffer intervals, notification delivery and post-marker return are upper bounds including driver/handlers/scheduling, not pure CPU wakeup
Bare has no Metal timestamps; marker may perturb waits; compare bare task results separately
Capacity comparison reloads models; not a claim about switching capacity for free during live tasks; fixed case order and temporal drift remain
No snapshots/eviction or physical KV reduction, no Windows/CUDA; all negative pairs retained; seven repeats do not support tail guarantees
